narrative.overview: A personal portfolio built as a night survey of Crete: the hero is a living topographic contour field drawn as network infrastructure, and every section below reads like the measured plates of an engineering report. The interface recedes; the terrain and the record lead. The system is dark and quiet so that two things can be loud: the teal signal accent and the facts. Depth comes from layered linework and staggered motion, never from shadows or glass.
keyCharacteristics: Deep ink-navy ground with one electric teal accent reserved for signals
Crisp geometric canvas/SVG linework as the only imagery
Archivo semi-expanded caps for display; Martian Mono only for real data
Parallax and reveal choreography with exponential ease-out; reduced-motion collapses to static
Square corners everywhere; the system owns zero border radii

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal appears only where something is true, actionable, or measured. If teal decorates, it is wrong.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Gray Rule
rules.body: Every text and line color is tinted toward the terrain blue. A pure gray on this page is a bug.

rules.name: The Data-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono is earned by content: a number, a date, an ID, a coordinate. Mono for technical vibe is a costume.

rules.name: The Linework-Over-Glow Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from drawn lines and layered parallax. Glows, halos, and blur panels do not exist here.

dos: Do keep every neutral tinted toward the terrain blue; body text >= 4.5:1 on the ground.
Do use Martian Mono only for real data — dates, coordinates, IDs, tags.
Do let the canvas rest: fewer, brighter contour bands beat many faint ones.
Do gate hidden pre-states behind the .js class so the page is fully readable without JavaScript.
donts: Don't add eyebrows/kickers above headings, section numbers, or icon-in-box card grids.
Don't introduce gradients on text, glass blur, glow halos, or side-stripe borders.
Don't load any third-party font, script, or tracker; everything ships from the site's own origin.
Don't place contact information other than location and the LinkedIn link; no email, phone, or address.
